# Signing an identity

The host's server signs the person's id and email (and roles, with the time of signing) with the project's verification secret (`vs_`, from the Configuration page, Identity tab). The browser passes the signature to `Opem.identify`. The secret never reaches the browser.

## Node.js, with `@opem/node`

`signIdentity` builds the canonical string and the HMAC for you.

```ts file=identify-server.ts
import { signIdentity } from "@opem/node";

const signedAt = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
const signature = signIdentity(
  {
    id: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    roles: user.roles,
    signedAt,
  },
  process.env.OPEM_VERIFICATION_SECRET, // vs_…
);
```

## The browser, after sign-in

Fetch the signed identity from your server and pass it to the widget.

```ts file=identify-browser.ts
Opem.identify({
  id: user.id,
  email: user.email,
  name: user.name,
  roles: user.roles,
  signedAt: user.opemSignedAt,
  signature: user.opemSignature, // from your server
});
```

## Python

The same HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical string, without a library.

```python file=identity/sign.py
import hashlib
import hmac
import os


def opem_signature(user_id: str, email: str | None, roles: list[str], signed_at: int) -> str:
    """Sign on your server; signed_at is int(time.time()), passed to Opem.identify() as signedAt."""
    message = f"{user_id}\n{(email or '').lower()}"
    if roles:
        message += "\n" + ",".join(sorted(roles)) + f"\n{signed_at}"
    secret = os.environ["OPEM_VERIFICATION_SECRET"].encode()
    return hmac.new(secret, message.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
```

## Ruby



```ruby file=identity/sign.rb
require "openssl"

# Sign on your server; signed_at is Time.now.to_i, passed to Opem.identify() as signedAt.
def opem_signature(user_id, email, roles, signed_at)
  message = "#{user_id}\n#{email.to_s.downcase}"
  roles = Array(roles).sort
  message += "\n#{roles.join(",")}\n#{signed_at}" unless roles.empty?
  OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest("SHA256", ENV.fetch("OPEM_VERIFICATION_SECRET"), message)
end
```

## PHP



```php file=identity/sign.php
<?php

// Sign on your server; $signedAt is time(), passed to Opem.identify() as signedAt.
function opemSignature(string $userId, ?string $email, array $roles, int $signedAt): string
{
    $message = $userId . "\n" . strtolower($email ?? '');
    sort($roles, SORT_STRING);
    if ($roles) {
        $message .= "\n" . implode(',', $roles) . "\n" . $signedAt;
    }
    return hash_hmac('sha256', $message, getenv('OPEM_VERIFICATION_SECRET'));
}
```

## Go



```go file=identity/sign.go
package main

import (
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

// OpemSignature signs on your server; signedAt is time.Now().Unix(), passed to Opem.identify() as signedAt.
func OpemSignature(userID, email string, roles []string, signedAt int64) string {
	message := userID + "\n" + strings.ToLower(email)
	if len(roles) > 0 {
		sorted := slices.Clone(roles)
		slices.Sort(sorted)
		message += "\n" + strings.Join(sorted, ",") + "\n" + strconv.FormatInt(signedAt, 10)
	}
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(os.Getenv("OPEM_VERIFICATION_SECRET")))
	mac.Write([]byte(message))
	return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}
```

## C#

A static class with the standard library only; .NET 6 or later.

```csharp file=identity/sign.cs
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

public static class OpemIdentity
{
    // Sign on your server; signedAt is DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds(), passed to Opem.identify() as signedAt.
    public static string Signature(string userId, string? email, string[] roles, long signedAt)
    {
        var message = userId + "\n" + (email ?? "").ToLowerInvariant();
        if (roles.Length > 0)
        {
            var sorted = roles.OrderBy(role => role, StringComparer.Ordinal);
            message += "\n" + string.Join(",", sorted) + "\n" + signedAt.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }
        var secret = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("OPEM_VERIFICATION_SECRET")!);
        var mac = HMACSHA256.HashData(secret, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message));
        return Convert.ToHexString(mac).ToLowerInvariant();
    }
}
```

## Java

A final class with the standard library only; Java 17 or later.

```java file=identity/sign.java
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.GeneralSecurityException;
import java.util.HexFormat;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import javax.crypto.Mac;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;

public final class OpemIdentity {
    // Sign on your server; signedAt is Instant.now().getEpochSecond(), passed to Opem.identify() as signedAt.
    public static String signature(String userId, String email, List<String> roles, long signedAt)
            throws GeneralSecurityException {
        String message = userId + "\n" + (email == null ? "" : email.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
        if (!roles.isEmpty()) {
            List<String> sorted = roles.stream().sorted().toList();
            message += "\n" + String.join(",", sorted) + "\n" + signedAt;
        }
        byte[] secret = System.getenv("OPEM_VERIFICATION_SECRET").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        Mac mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256");
        mac.init(new SecretKeySpec(secret, "HmacSHA256"));
        return HexFormat.of().formatHex(mac.doFinal(message.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
    }
}
```
